title: Reading Drill — Planning a ferry boarding area — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Planning a ferry boarding area — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The terminal planner in Cairnford received an old report about groups of passengers meeting in a narrow gate. The report compared boarding queue length, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the manual counts rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered three weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include large tour groups. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed separate waiting lines as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
